scope_warning: This closes only the K5/P3 toy theorem. It does not certify any cover6-d8 residual formula or any new Ramsey bound.
mathematical_statement: Every red/blue colouring of K5 with no monochromatic triangle contains an induced positive P3.
color_convention: A true Lean value and a positive one-based DIMACS literal both mean a raw positive/red edge.

observed_axioms: native_decide axioms tied to the exact LRAT replay, formula equality, and finite embedding enumeration

negative_tests: a flipped Ramsey literal is rejected by exhaustive component semantics
a flipped induced-motif polarity is rejected by exhaustive component semantics
a zero-based DIMACS literal is rejected by the parser
a trivially UNSAT formula obtained by adding an empty clause is rejected as the wrong mathematical encoding before replay
a one-byte LRAT mutation is rejected by the frozen identity guard
trust_boundary: Lean kernel plus the standard axioms listed above and the native compiler/runtime used by LRAT-Catcher and native_decide. CaDiCaL's checkproof=2 was also run, but the independent decisive replay is LRAT-Catcher/Lean.
